item.text:
Yes. An agent can use the built-in `web_search` tool and return its final answer in JSON format.

Configure both in the agent’s `completion_args`:

```python
agent = client.beta.agents.create(
    model="mistral-medium-latest",
    name="Research agent",
    instructions="Search the web and return the result as JSON.",
    tools=[{"type": "web_search"}],
    completion_args={
        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"}
    },
)
```

Mistral documents `web_search` as an Agents API tool, and the Agents API exposes `completion_args` for response formatting. JSON mode requires explicitly instructing the model to output JSON. The web-search references are returned as separate reference chunks, so account for those when parsing the conversation response.

Sources: [Websearch](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools/websearch), [Beta Agents API](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/beta/agents), [Structured Outputs](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/conversations/structured-output).
